notes: Portals is on the approved layout: the panel cards on the left, the selected panel's details on the right, with the first card selected so the pane is never empty.

The pane READS and the card ACTS. Open/Close, Edit and Remove stay on the card rather than being repeated in the pane — a second copy of a control is how the status card and the Displays list ended up disagreeing about whether a panel was…
Pressing a card's own button no longer risks selecting it: the click handler ignores anything inside a .thm-btn. Without that guard, pressing Remove would select the panel being removed.

Selection survives a re-render. The list rebuilds on every open, close, add and remove, so the pane re-points at the panel you were reading rather than snapping back to the first each time — and its Status updates with it.
